description: Identifies browser, engine, OS, device class and known crawlers, AI bots and HTTP clients from a User-Agent string. Rule-based; user agents can be spoofed. Returns { browser: { name, version }, engine, os: { name, version }, device, isBot, bot } Price: 1 credit (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.
name: user-agent-parse
title: User-agent parser
